name: tradetime-mcp

tools.name: is_market_open
tools.description: Is a stock exchange open for trading right now (or at a given time)? Returns { open: true/false } plus status, when it next opens (weekends and holidays are skipped), and when it closes if currently open. The fastest answer to "is <exchange> open?".

exchange.description: Exchange id (e.g. "nyse", "nasdaq", "lse", "nikkei", "hkex") OR common name/city (e.g. "New York Stock Exchange", "Tokyo", "London"). Case-insensitive.

at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp to evaluate AT a specific moment (e.g. "2026-07-06T14:30:00Z"). Defaults to now. Use it for "will the NYSE be open at 3pm ET on Monday?".

tools.name: get_exchange_status
tools.description: Full live status for one exchange: open flag, status enum (main_open / session_open / opening_soon / closed), session type, hours to the next transition, hours to close (if open), and why it is closed (holiday / weekend) if applicable.

exchange.description: Exchange id (e.g. "nyse", "nasdaq", "lse", "nikkei", "hkex") OR common name/city (e.g. "New York Stock Exchange", "Tokyo", "London"). Case-insensitive.

at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp to evaluate AT a specific moment (e.g. "2026-07-06T14:30:00Z"). Defaults to now. Use it for "will the NYSE be open at 3pm ET on Monday?".

tools.name: markets_open_now
tools.description: Which of the world's stock exchanges are open right now (or at a given time)? Returns every tracked exchange with its open flag and status — ideal for "which markets are trading?".

at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp to evaluate AT a specific moment (e.g. "2026-07-06T14:30:00Z"). Defaults to now. Use it for "will the NYSE be open at 3pm ET on Monday?".

tools.name: time_until_next_open
tools.description: When does an exchange next open? Returns hours until the next open (weekends and holidays skipped), or — if it is already open — hours until it closes.

exchange.description: Exchange id (e.g. "nyse", "nasdaq", "lse", "nikkei", "hkex") OR common name/city (e.g. "New York Stock Exchange", "Tokyo", "London"). Case-insensitive.

at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp to evaluate AT a specific moment (e.g. "2026-07-06T14:30:00Z"). Defaults to now. Use it for "will the NYSE be open at 3pm ET on Monday?".

tools.name: list_exchanges
tools.description: List the tracked stock exchanges as lightweight summaries (id, name, city, country, timezone, region, importance). Optionally filter by region (e.g. "Asia", "Americas", "Europe"). Use this to discover valid exchange ids.

tools.name: get_exchange
tools.description: The full record for one exchange: sessions (in exchange-local decimal hours), holidays, early closes, and official source links.

exchange.description: Exchange id (e.g. "nyse", "nasdaq", "lse", "nikkei", "hkex") OR common name/city (e.g. "New York Stock Exchange", "Tokyo", "London"). Case-insensitive.

tools.name: get_holidays
tools.description: The closure calendar for one exchange: full-day holidays (YYYY-MM-DD, exchange-local) and early-close days with their close times.

exchange.description: Exchange id (e.g. "nyse", "nasdaq", "lse", "nikkei", "hkex") OR common name/city (e.g. "New York Stock Exchange", "Tokyo", "London"). Case-insensitive.

tools.name: get_trading_sessions
tools.description: The trading-session structure for one exchange, in exchange-local decimal hours (9.5 = 09:30). A four-number "main" means a lunch break (e.g. Tokyo 9–11.5, 12.5–15).

exchange.description: Exchange id (e.g. "nyse", "nasdaq", "lse", "nikkei", "hkex") OR common name/city (e.g. "New York Stock Exchange", "Tokyo", "London"). Case-insensitive.

instructions: Global stock-exchange trading hours from TradeTi.me. Use is_market_open for "is <exchange> open now?", markets_open_now for "which markets are trading?", time_until_next_open for countdowns, and get_holidays / get_trading_sessions / list_exchanges / get_exchange for reference data. Times are exchange-LOCAL facts (open/close/holidays do not shift with the caller's timezone); pass an ISO `at` to evaluate any moment. The data is a convenience, not an authoritative or real-time feed — verify with the exchange before any time-sensitive or financial decision.
